intent.verbatim: calibrate the assessor against human labels — score true-positive and true-negative separately so a sycophant judge gets caught
intent.decoded: `socom judge` scores a model assessor against human labels with TPR/TNR reported separately; the gate blocks unless both meet threshold (Phase-2b, GAPS #4 — raw agreement misleads under imbalance).

contract.goal: The judge command exists and reports the true-positive / true-negative rates.

check.expect: exit 0: the judge command is compiled in
exit 0: TPR/TNR calibration is present (not raw agreement only)

contract.out-of-scope: The labelled-set curation loop; this gates the calibrated scorer exists.
contract.regression-surface: Collapsing to raw-agreement or removing judge must turn this RED.
